title: Easy G-Apple
description: This DataPack makes crafting Golden Apples easier.
body:
# Golden Apple Cross Recipe
An alternative crafting recipe for the Golden Apple: instead of the vanilla 8 gold ingots, you only need 4, arranged in a cross pattern around the apple.

![The Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc89a61b8943f3d1038e0261503110b26c083b66.png)

A cheaper, more balanced way to craft golden apples in survival, without needing a full gold block.

## Features
Overwrites the vanilla recipe directly — no new items, no dependencies
Compatible with every version from 1.13 to 26.2 (separate zips for each version range)
No mods required: works on vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt — any loader, since it's a pure data pack
## Installation
Download the zip matching your Minecraft version
Copy it (or its contents) into .minecraft/saves/<world name>/datapacks/
Run /reload in-game, or reopen the world
